scope: Existing benchmarks; no new model or judge calls and no manuscript edits

criteria.requirement: Pin original source records, references, parser, evaluator and captured outputs; verify source identities.
Demonstrate exactly what changed at the executable boundary; source-only/AST/fixture/ordinary imports/full entrypoint separated.
For measurement consequence keep generated output bytes fixed and change only the faulty interpretation; retain the original parser where possible.
Quantify a conclusion affected, including content-blind baseline comparisons or oracle impossibility, not merely an alert.
Retain incomplete outputs as unknown; check healthy controls and supported configurations; do not label displayed zero with zero valid references as model inaccuracy.

exposure: Existing scores and candidate failures already known. This is not a new preregistered discovery.
not_required: A ranking reversal between published headline methods is not necessary for a local causal consequence.
not_established_automatically: Novelty, external published leaderboard impact, or superiority to GAMMAF.
